implementation.public_creation: Normal PmSimulationCreateInfo creation with a NULL pNext enters the complete fixed-tick production runtime. The execution-profile extension and enumeration command were removed from the registry, headers, generated reference artifacts, loader, validation layer and drivers.
implementation.single_schedule: Runtime stepping unconditionally records the complete fixed schedule. The selector branch and reference_schedule.hpp legacy scheduler were deleted; no public mode flag, environment variable or build option selects another production engine.
implementation.fixed_tick: Every accepted step uses one substep at 1/60 second within one binary32 ULP. Other timestep or substep requests fail explicitly rather than changing schedules.
implementation.versioning: The public API is 0.3 and the private driver interface is 2. API 0.2 and other incompatible requests are rejected; MIGRATION.md and release/reference artifacts describe the breaking change.
implementation.application_model: The create/resources/commands/submit/output model remains intact, including asynchronous submission, diagnostics, recovery and all previously advertised domain and interaction resources.
implementation.adapter_parity: CPU, CUDA, Metal, D3D12 and Vulkan wrappers bind the same production schedule and shared Slang operators. CUDA, desktop Vulkan and Android Vulkan builds prove the changed binding signatures available on this host.
implementation.rope_attachment_regression: Rope endpoint contact-skip ranges exclude their attached rigid bodies during deformable/rigid collision, preserving exact anchored position and zero velocity on the physical Vulkan path.

public_cases: simulation creation succeeds without an execution-profile extension and exposes no profile enumeration entrypoint
fixed 1/60-second, one-substep commands execute rigid, liquid, cloth, soft-body, rope, smoke and coupling work through one schedule
incompatible timestep, substep, API and driver ABI requests fail explicitly
headless command, asynchronous submission, liquid and complete mixed-domain realtime tests pass through the ordinary public API
attached rope endpoints remain exact while neighboring nodes still participate in rigid collision
installed C and C++ consumers build and execute against API 0.3
